mermaid 12.2.0 (MIT, see LICENSE), dist/mermaid.min.js unchanged from the npm tarball.

Fetched with:
  curl -sS -o mermaid.tgz https://registry.npmjs.org/mermaid/-/mermaid-12.2.0.tgz
  tar xzf mermaid.tgz package/dist/mermaid.min.js package/LICENSE

It is loaded only by the mermaid frame (/mermaid-frame, js/mermaid-frame.js), a
same-origin iframe the app creates when the first diagram is on screen. It is
never in index.html or the boot scripts, and nothing is fetched from a CDN.
